links.outcome: LLM response robustness to prompt variability across combinatorial test cases
links.effect: LLMs responded positively to more concrete system-prompt instructions but remained vulnerable to overall prompt variability (1,000 test cases built combinatorially).
links.quote: LLMs respond positively to more concrete instructions in the system prompt but remain vulnerable to overall prompt variability.

links.outcome: LLM performance differences across age groups
links.effect: Performance was heterogeneous across three age groups, displaying age-related biases, possibly due to differential disease prevalence.
links.quote: Moreover, LLM performance is heterogeneous across different age groups, displaying age-related biases, which may, however, be due to differential disease prevalence.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-a-judge automated evaluation assisted by expert commentaries
using more concrete system prompt instructions to improve LLM recommendation quality

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance and safety of multiple LLMs in generating personalized biomarker-based health intervention recommendations across synthetic profiles, without testing a specific deployment practice or operational safeguard.
